text: Ten fictional nonprofit passages across the requested sectors and genres, each with eight citation variants.

passages.source_passage: In 2023, the Kelvane Rural Water Trust drilled 14 new boreholes across Orrin District and built 312 household latrines. Eleven of the boreholes were handed over to village water committees by October. Three sites did not reach handover because the access road flooded in September, and no spare pumps could be delivered before the rains ended. Handwashing stations were installed at 27 schools, and 68% of pupils surveyed in December reported using them after toilet visits. We did not meet our target of 400 latrines, mainly because masons were scarce.

variants.whitespace_case:
ELEVEN of the boreholes were  handed over to village water committees
by October.
variants.punctuation: In 2023 the Kelvane Rural Water Trust drilled 14 new boreholes across Orrin District, and built 312 household latrines.
variants.changed_quantity: Handwashing stations were installed at 27 schools, and 72% of pupils surveyed in December reported using them after toilet visits.
variants.added_negation: Eleven of the boreholes were not handed over to village water committees by October.
variants.removed_negation: We did meet our target of 400 latrines, mainly because masons were scarce.
variants.reordered: the Kelvane Rural Water Trust drilled 14 new latrines across Orrin District and built 312 household boreholes
variants.paraphrase: Three sites were not handed over, as the road to them was flooded in September and replacement pumps could not arrive before the rains ended.

passages.source_passage: Youth unemployment in the Tamsin Valley stands at an estimated 41%, nearly double the national rate. The Haldane Vocational Training Centre, founded in 2016, has trained 1,850 young people in welding, tailoring and solar installation. However, only about half of graduates find paid work within six months, and the centre has never tracked those who move to other towns. Employers say graduates lack workplace experience, not technical skill. This proposal seeks funding to place 300 trainees in three-month apprenticeships over the next 24 months, supported by a small stipend of 40 dollars per month.

variants.exact: Employers say graduates lack workplace experience, not technical skill.
variants.whitespace_case: YOUTH UNEMPLOYMENT in the Tamsin  Valley stands at an estimated 41%, nearly double the national rate.
variants.punctuation: This proposal seeks funding to place 300 trainees in three month apprenticeships over the next 24 months supported by a small stipend of 40 dollars per month.
variants.changed_quantity: Youth unemployment in the Tamsin Valley stands at an estimated 14%, nearly double the national rate.
variants.added_negation: The Haldane Vocational Training Centre, founded in 2016, has not trained 1,850 young people in welding, tailoring and solar installation.
variants.removed_negation: However, only about half of graduates find paid work within six months, and the centre has tracked those who move to other towns.
variants.reordered: Graduates say employers lack workplace experience, not technical skill.
variants.paraphrase: Employers believe the problem is that young graduates have no experience of real workplaces rather than a shortage of technical ability.

passages.source_passage: During the 2022 long-rains season, the Mbali Farmer Field School Network monitored 62 schools with a combined membership of 1,540 farmers, of whom 58% were women. Farmers who followed the improved maize spacing recorded average yields of 3.1 tonnes per hectare, compared with 1.9 tonnes on neighbouring plots. Seed quality was not a limiting factor, since all groups received certified seed. Facilitators did not complete the planned soil testing in nine schools because the testing kits arrived late. Attendance at weekly sessions averaged 71%, and no school closed during the season.

since ALL GROUPS received certified seed.

variants.removed_negation: Facilitators did complete the planned soil testing in nine schools because the testing kits arrived late.
variants.reordered: Kits did not complete the planned soil testing in nine schools because the testing facilitators arrived late.
variants.paraphrase: Because every group was given certified seed, the quality of seed did not hold back results.

passages.source_passage: Between March and August 2023, the Sunreach Cash Programme made six monthly payments of 25 dollars to 4,200 households in Dalwen County. Post-distribution monitoring found that 91% of recipients collected their full amount without paying any fee. Households did not report a rise in food prices at the local market, although two traders said demand had increased. The share of households eating fewer than two meals a day fell from 46% to 29%. Complaints were not common: only 37 were logged, most about delayed SMS notices. Mobile network coverage remains weak in the northern wards.

variants.whitespace_case: post-distribution monitoring found that 91% of  recipients collected their full amount without paying any fee.
variants.punctuation: Between March and August 2023 the Sunreach Cash Programme made six monthly payments of 25 dollars to 4,200 households in Dalwen County.

variants.removed_negation: Households did report a rise in food prices at the local market, although two traders said demand had increased.
variants.reordered: Traders did not report a rise in food prices at the local market, although two households said demand had increased.
variants.paraphrase: About nine in ten recipients got the whole transfer and were not charged anything to receive it.

passages.source_passage: In the quarter ending 30 June 2024, the Linden Hospice Outreach home-visiting team made 1,126 visits to 214 clients living with HIV. Volunteers did not provide medical treatment; they checked medication adherence, offered nutrition advice and referred clients to the clinic. Of the 214 clients, 187 were on antiretroviral therapy, and 9 had missed their clinic appointments for more than a month. No client reported being refused care by a volunteer. Supervisors accompanied each volunteer on at least one visit, but two rural routes were not covered in May because of fuel shortages.

passages.source_passage: In Karesh Province there is one practising lawyer for every 28,000 residents, and most live more than 60 kilometres from a court. Since 2019 the Bridgeway Paralegal Service has trained 85 community paralegals who help people with land disputes, birth registration and domestic violence cases. Paralegals do not charge fees and cannot represent clients in court. In 2023 they resolved about 1,300 cases through mediation, but 22% of clients still needed referral to a lawyer, and the service had no funds to cover legal fees. We propose to expand coverage to four more districts.

passages.source_passage: The Ndola Evening Literacy Network ran 38 classes in the first term of 2024, enrolling 760 adults, of whom 81% were women aged over 30. Average attendance was 64%, lower than the 75% target. Learners who attended at least 20 of 30 sessions gained an average of two reading levels. Instructors reported that lamps were not available in eleven classrooms, so lessons ended before dark. The network has never received government funding, and volunteer instructors are not paid. A second reading assessment is scheduled for July 2024.

variants.whitespace_case: Instructors reported that lamps were not available in ELEVEN classrooms,  so lessons ended before dark.

variants.reordered: The government has never received network funding, and volunteer instructors are not paid.
variants.paraphrase: Learners who came to two-thirds or more of the thirty sessions improved by about two reading levels.

passages.source_passage: At mid-term in March 2024, the Tuwaka Village Savings and Loan Programme had formed 143 groups with 3,380 members, exceeding its 2,500-member target. Groups saved a median of 4.5 dollars per member each month, and repayment on loans was 96%. The evaluation did not find evidence that loans were being used for consumption rather than small businesses, although the sample was limited to 12 villages. Women held 74% of chair positions, but no group had a treasurer under the age of 25. Record-keeping remains the main weakness. We recommend extending the programme by one year.

variants.whitespace_case: Women held 74% of chair positions, but NO GROUP had a treasurer under  the age of 25.
variants.punctuation: The evaluation did not find evidence that loans were being used for consumption, rather than small businesses, although the sample was limited to 12 villages.

variants.added_negation: We recommend not extending the programme by one year.
variants.removed_negation: The evaluation did find evidence that loans were being used for consumption rather than small businesses, although the sample was limited to 12 villages.
variants.reordered: Members saved a median of 4.5 dollars per group each month, and repayment on loans was 96%.
variants.paraphrase: Most chairs were women, at 74%, yet there wasn't a single group with a treasurer younger than 25.

passages.source_passage: Malaria remains the leading cause of clinic visits in Oruwai Sub-County, accounting for roughly 38% of outpatient cases in 2023. The last mass net distribution took place in 2020, and surveys show that only 52% of households now own enough nets for every two people. Nets older than three years are not effective because the insecticide wears off. The Kiyanga Health Alliance did not run the 2020 campaign, but it will work with the district health office, which did. We aim to distribute 18,000 nets to 9,000 households by December 2025.

variants.removed_negation: The Kiyanga Health Alliance did run the 2020 campaign, but it will work with the district health office, which did.
variants.reordered: and surveys show that only 52% of households now own enough people for every two nets.
variants.paraphrase: Roughly four in ten outpatient cases in the sub-county in 2023 were due to malaria, making it the most common reason people attended clinics.

passages.source_passage: The Pilimbi Community Playgroup Network now runs 54 playgroups for children aged three to five, up from 39 at the start of the year. Each playgroup meets on four mornings a week and is led by a trained caregiver, not a qualified teacher. A baseline assessment of 600 children in January found that 44% were not meeting expected language milestones. Funding for caregiver stipends has not yet been confirmed beyond September, and the board should not assume renewal. Parents contributed an average of 3 dollars each month. The next assessment will be held in November 2024.
